integrity: Proof includes analytic matrix interpolation, regular-branch isometries, a critical Lucas square normal form, and integer square-root counts. The checker compares whole periods through 19^4; finite checks are not substitutes for the proof. Primary literature, including closely relevant image-density results, is credited.
scientific_limitations: Only standard Fibonacci residues modulo powers of 19. Image sizes and limiting image density 441/760 were established in prior published work and are not new. The claim concerns complete target-specific fiber counts and their unbounded maxima; independent audit and global priority certification have not occurred.
title: Exact \(19\)-adic Fibonacci residue fibers and a singular square branch
